findings.title: Password floor/cap diverged across auth, master, SPA
findings.description: One product rule (min length + bcrypt 72-byte cap) is reimplemented and already disagrees. auth.validatePasswordAgainst (handler.go:1224) uses utf8.RuneCount vs policy floor and len>MaxPasswordLen=72. settings.setMasterInput.Validate (dto.go:41) uses len() bytes vs hardcoded minMasterPasswordLen=8 and has no 72-byte cap — pwhash.Hash then 500s. web masterPasswordForm.ts:20 hardcodes length<8. passwordStrength.ts:16 hardcodes >=8 and claims to match the master floor. Account SPA (useInstancePolicy.passwordGateLen) already follows live policy+72. folders/dto.go:49 uses len() vs min 4 and also skips the 72-byte cap. Auth comment (handler.go:26) says the product has ONE number; policy raises leave master+meter at 8.
findings.fix: Export one PasswordBounds helper next to auth.validatePasswordAgainst (rune min from policy, byte max 72). Call it from settings master Validate and folder password Validate (cap only). SPA: masterPasswordForm + passwordChecks must use passwordGateLen/usePasswordFloor, not literal 8.

findings.title: HasSecondFactor copies still read totp_enabled alone
findings.description: INV-005 / HasSecondFactor is TOTP OR email. Canonical: auth/model.go:173 and web hasSecondFactor (types.ts:57). SettingsPage.tsx:213 already uses the helper, but IdentityHero at SettingsPage.tsx:370 sets needs2fa=!me.totp_enabled — email-only accounts see '2FA off' on the hub hero. AdminUsersPage.tsx:198 shows admin.has_2fa only when totp_enabled. types.ts:51 documents this exact prior drift. AccountHero.tsx:19 is correct.
findings.fix: Replace remaining totp_enabled 'has 2FA' reads with hasSecondFactor(user). Keep totp_enabled only for authenticator-specific UI.

findings.title: http(s) URL gate forked: Host vs ToLower vs prefix
findings.description: urls.go:13 ValidateAbsoluteHTTPURL is the documented single scheme rule (DTO + JSON import): requires Host, scheme == http|https (case-sensitive). Netscape isHTTPScheme (netscape.go:201) and screenshot isHTTPScheme (screenshot_handler.go:438) ToLower the scheme and skip Host — HTTP://example.com and https: (empty host) pass Netscape, fail CRUD/JSON. metadata_handler.go:108 re-parses instead of calling ValidateAbsoluteHTTPURL (different error codes, extra length cap). redirect/handler.go:100 uses HasPrefix http://|https:// (also case-sensitive, no parse). preview/fetcher.go:64 and netpolicy.go:108 are more copies; netpolicy does check Hostname.
findings.fix: Make ValidateAbsoluteHTTPURL (or netpolicy) the only write-path predicate. Netscape + metadata + screenshot scheme pre-check must call it. Keep redirect HasPrefix as defense-in-depth or fold into the same helper.

findings.title: Hostname allowlist copied: A-Z vs lowercase-only
findings.description: auth.validEmailDomain (handler.go:1269) comments it is the same allowlist as policy.validDomain (policy.go:199). They are not: policy accepts only a-z (Google domain list is folded); auth also accepts A-Z because addresses are not folded first. Both cap at 253 and share the hyphen/label skeleton. A rule change (IDNA, underscore, punycode) must be applied twice or Google allowlist vs signup email disagree on Example.COM vs example.com after folding.
findings.fix: One validHostname(s, allowUpper bool) in a tiny pkg (or fold then call policy.validDomain from auth after ToLower of the domain part).

findings.title: Image upload admission is a T3 twin that drifted
findings.description: links.ScreenshotHandler.UploadImage (screenshot_handler.go:499) and notes.ImageHandler.Upload (image_handler.go:55) share 5MiB, DetectContentType vs AllowedUploadMIMEs, OptimizeForStore, same 413/415 envelopes. Already diverged: ParseMultipartForm+empty_file vs MultipartReader that maps empty to missing_image; notes skips empty-file as a distinct 400. MIME/size/optimize must change together (notes comment even says it mirrors the 5MiB cap).
findings.fix: Extract ReadUploadedImage(r, max) in imageopt (MaxBytesReader, field 'image', size, MIME, OptimizeForStore). Handlers keep ownership/lease/key policy only.

findings.title: Hint-must-not-equal-password copied with trim drift

'  Secret' vs hint 'secret' can pass the SPA and fail the API, or the reverse depending on which path trims.
findings.fix: One HintEqualsPassword(hint, password string) bool (trim + EqualFold) in a small shared helper; SPA ports the same trim before compare.
